key_insight: We DON'T need the CRS310 right away. The old MikroTik might already have SFP!

phase_1_NOW.title: CURRENT — no changes, just free northGate
phase_1_NOW.eastGate: stays on RJ45 via MikroTik (10Gbps enp5s0, 0.25ms)
phase_1_NOW.northGate: FREE — Kevin's chair, gaming, Steam, RustDesk

phase_2_ATT_TAKEOVER.title: Strip ATT router — get IP Passthrough or bypass
actions: Factory reset MikroTik (get admin access, see model + SFP ports)
If MikroTik has SFP: great, it becomes fiber core later
Extract 802.1X from ATT BGW (or just keep IP Passthrough)
Move ATT box to wall near fiber ingress

phase_3_SWAP.title: MikroTik takes over at fiber ingress
phase_3_SWAP.action: Move MikroTik to wall next to ATT box
phase_3_SWAP.swap: Move the 10G fiber line (currently Flint -> JetStream) INTO the MikroTik SFP

result.Flint: WiFi AP only — just needs one RJ45 uplink to MikroTik

phase_4_DESK.title: HEAD AND SHOULDERS at Kevin's desk/chair
phase_4_DESK.MikroTik: AT the wall/ingress — fiber to House 2, RJ45 to desk

at_desk.northGate: RJ45 from MikroTik — Kevin's gaming/Steam/dev PC

phase_4_DESK.fiber: ONLY for House 2 backbone (MikroTik SFP -> JetStream 10G)

later_CRS310.title: CRS310 is a LATER upgrade if we want more fiber
later_CRS310.when: After Phase 3 is stable and we want eastGate on 10G fiber too
later_CRS310.or: If MikroTik doesn't have SFP, then CRS310 replaces it

summary.Phase 3: ~$10 — swap MikroTik to wall, fiber to House 2, RJ45 to desk
summary.Phase 4: $0 — head and shoulders at desk (northGate + eastGate on RJ45)
summary.Later: ~$250-292 — CRS310 if we want full fiber backbone
